
# THIS PROJECT IS GENERATED BY AI

想象一下这样的场景：

在2026年，你是一个传统派，买了个二十刀的plan，平时当一个advanced google用，甚至连5hr额度都没用完过。
此时你发现你的订阅已经过去了两周，每周的额度只用了5%，你感觉好亏啊，于是开启了你的第一个vibe code project。
你仔细设计了架构，写了上千字的提示词，最后甚至吧 nix file 都给写了，发现5hr只用了一半的时候。

**tm你们到底是怎么用完那些token的？？？**

有时候就感觉，在2026年，我连20刀plan都用不完，就感觉很丢人，完全被时代抛下了。或许这就是为什么程序员有35危机...
用点时代热梗来表述一下我现在的感觉就是：自己写的东西，用着不烧心。

想象一下我想尽办法消耗了一半5hr额度，最后我花了5hr去review ai代码，回来一看额度又清零了。
或许这是一件好事吧，但不可否认的是，我的工作效率就是要比其他人低，甚至我写的代码质量也没有多高。
但至少我了解整个项目，我知道每一行代码在干啥，坚持不用ai的原因归根到底就是：自己写的不烧心。

我不会签名 AI 生成的代码，所以 unverified

Picture this:

Sometimes it feels a bit embarrassing: it's 2026 and I can't even use up a $20 plan. I've been left completely behind. Maybe this is why programmers are supposedly washed up at 35...
To borrow a meme of the moment: homemade code goes down easy. No heartburn.

Picture it: I try everything I can think of and finally burn through half my 5-hour quota. Then I spend five hours reviewing the AI's code, come back, and the quota has reset to zero.
Maybe that's a good thing. But there's no denying I'm less productive than everyone else, and my code isn't even that good.
But at least I understand the whole project. I know what every line is doing. When it comes down to it, the reason I keep writing code without AI is simple: what you write yourself doesn't burn.

Some extra info on Chinese memes:
**"No heartburn" (不烧心).** In the fall of 2026, a flood of nearly identical AI-generated short dramas took over Chinese video apps. The plot never changes. An honest street-food vendor refuses to cut corners even as ingredient prices rise. A rival undercuts him with cheap, shady ingredients and steals his customers. Then the rival's food goes bad, and the loyal regulars come back with the same line every time: "It's a little pricey, but it doesn't give you heartburn." The line was repeated so often that it became a meme of its own. People now use "no heartburn" for anything that feels honest, reliable, and free of nasty surprises: a job, a car ride, even a lazy cat. In this README the phrase does double duty. Code I write myself is trustworthy and easy to live with, and it doesn't burn through any tokens either. It's also worth noting that the meme itself was born in an AI content mill.

**"Washed up at 35" (35岁危机).** In China's tech industry, 35 is widely treated as an unofficial expiration date. Many job postings cap applicants at 35. Older engineers are seen as more expensive and less willing to grind through "996" hours (9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week), and they are often the first to go in layoffs. The cutoff for most civil service exams is also 35, which closes off a common fallback. "The 35 crisis" has become shorthand for the fear that if you stop keeping up, the industry will quietly push you out. Here the author jokes that falling behind on AI tools might be exactly how that happens.


# lamacloud-auth-addon

Custom Zitadel login UI (Login V2 API) with optional Yubico OTP as second factor.

- `packages/web`: Solid + Vite UI
- `packages/server`: Fastify backend, talks to Zitadel and the Yubico validation API

## Zitadel setup

1. Create a service user, give it the **IAM_LOGIN_CLIENT** role (instance level), create a PAT.
2. Enable Login V2 for the instance (or per app) with base URI = where this app is served,
   e.g. `https://login.example.com`. Zitadel redirects to `<baseURI>/login?authRequest=V2_...`.
3. Per user, to require a YubiKey: add user metadata `yubico_otp` (key configurable) with the
   key's public ID(s), i.e. the first 12 characters of an OTP, comma or whitespace separated.
   Users without this metadata only need their password.

## Config

`packages/server/config.json` (see `config.example.json`; pass another path with `--config`).
Yubico API credentials: https://upgrade.yubico.com/getapikey/

## Run

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm dev                 # web on :5173 (proxies /api), server on :3000
pnpm build
node packages/server/dist/index.js --config config.json   # set server.webRoot to packages/web/dist to serve the UI too
```

## Nix

- `package.nix`: the package (fill in the TODO GitHub owner/repo/hash). Output: `bin/lamacloud-auth-addon`,
  which also serves the bundled web UI. After changing dependencies, set `pnpmDeps.hash` to `lib.fakeHash`,
  build once and copy the hash from the error.
- `module.nix`: NixOS module `services.lamacloud-auth-addon`.

```nix
{
  imports = [ ./lamacloud-auth-addon/module.nix ];
  nixpkgs.overlays = [
    (final: prev: { lamacloud-auth-addon = final.callPackage ./lamacloud-auth-addon/package.nix { }; })
  ];
  services.lamacloud-auth-addon = {
    enable = true;
    # root-only (0600) is fine, the service reads it via systemd LoadCredential
    configFile = "/etc/lamacloud-auth-addon/config.json";
  };
}
```

## Not implemented yet

- `/logout` (Zitadel sends users there on end_session without id_token_hint)
- registration, SAML / device authorization requests, Zitadel-native MFA (TOTP, passkeys)
- SSO across apps: no Zitadel session is kept in the browser, so every app login asks again
